audit.framework_rationale: TensorCircuit performs state preparation, Hamiltonian construction, continuous-time evolution through ode_evol_global, digital rotations, and energy measurement. JAX, NumPy, and Optax provide numerical and optimization support; no other quantum framework is imported or used.
audit.cheating_rationale: The source computes energies and learned parameters through actual variational optimization. It contains no hardcoded answers, hidden-data access, evaluator manipulation, or test/reward tampering.
audit.fidelity_rationale: The implementation matches the open-boundary Hamiltonians, Neel initialization, bounded trainable analog parameters, Gaussian angle initialization, and four-block structure. Scaling the Hamiltonian by duration while integrating from zero to one correctly implements the requested evolution time. The ODE call receives the configured tolerances and step bound. Applying gamma, beta, then alpha realizes the stated RZ(alpha) RY(beta) RZ(gamma) operator. Adam performs exactly the configured number of updates, recording each pre-update energy density and returning the required NumPy arrays.
audit.implementation_error_rationale: No obvious implementation error is apparent. Parameter shapes, Hamiltonian coefficients, normalization, optimizer updates, and history timing are consistent with the specification.
